newsitem.title: FINLAND: NO WORD FROM HARTWALL ON CARLSBERG TALK.
newsitem.headline: NO WORD FROM HARTWALL ON CARLSBERG TALK.

text.p: No one at Finnish beverages group Hartwall Oy was available on Friday to comment on a report in daily Helsingin Sanomat that Danish Carlsberg might be indirectly buying a stake in the company.
The newspaper said the brewing giant was interested in Swedish Volvo's share of Swedish-Norwegian beverage group Pripps Ringes, which owns one-fifth of Hartwall shares.
Volvo owns 55 percent of Pripps Ringes, it said.
But a Hartwall official said all the company's executives were in outside meetings and no one could comment.
Shares in Hartwall rose sharply on the Helsinki Stock Exchange after the report on Friday, trading up 10.00 markka or almost six percent at 180.00.
